preconditions.name: density_read_discriminates
preconditions.description: ON field: density(dense) - density(sparse) clears floor (the density statistic the interaction contrast C1/C2 route on)
preconditions.control: DA-dense reward region vs equally-visited non-DA region

preconditions.name: selection_margin_responds_to_curiosity
preconditions.description: strong positive control (large curiosity_weight, dense ON field) yields a positive CEM score-MARGIN >= floor (the SAME margin statistic C1/C2 route on)

criteria.name: C1_interaction_margin_contrast
criteria.note: margin_both_on - (margin_sd024_on + margin_sd025_on - margin_both_off); super-additive 2x2 interaction in CONTINUOUS score-margin units (re-op of the saturating binary pref interaction)

criteria.name: C2_both_on_margin
criteria.note: both-ON produces a positive dense-preferring CEM score-margin (re-op of the saturating binary pref_both_on >= 0.60)

criteria.name: C3_sd025_alone_no_gradient
criteria.note: |margin_sd025_on| / |margin_both_on|: SD-024 OFF -> uniform density -> curiosity has no gradient -> ~0 directional margin

criteria.name: C4_interaction_rides_density_not_value
criteria.note: all benefit weights zeroed (value removed): interaction margin + both-ON margin persist because density is weight-independent

criteria.name: C5_sd024_alone_no_margin
criteria.note: |margin_sd024_on| / |margin_both_on|: density gradient exists but curiosity OFF

criteria.name: C7_value_non_discriminating
criteria.note: equal-mass design: value_dense ~ value_sparse -> value cannot drive the A-vs-B choice
